from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u090/system/state/workspace/programs/task-66dbb586.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=grid[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set()
    q=deque()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1)) and grid[r][c]==bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                seen.add((r,c)); q.append((r,c))
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc]==bg:
                seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==bg and (r,c) not in seen: out[r][c]=4
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(code)
